import json, os, subprocess, sys, ast
tree, home, calls = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
src = open(tree + "/governance/project/orchestration/tools/indep_launch.py").read()
doc = ast.get_docstring(ast.parse(src))
lines = [x.strip() for x in doc.splitlines() if x.strip().startswith("python3 ")]
extra = [l.replace("--sets-root ~/gov-os-eval", "--sets-root ~/gov-os-eval/indep-walls") for l in lines if "~/gov-os-eval" in l]
def decide(cmd):
    ev = {"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": cmd}, "cwd": tree, "session_id": "probe-s19", "agent_type": None}
    env = {"HOME": home, "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "LANG": "C.UTF-8", "GOV_ROLE": "orchestrator", "GOV_TICKET": "W2-00",
           "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": tree, "PYTHONPATH": tree + "/src", "GOV_GUARD_CALLS_DIR": calls}
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, tree + "/.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"], input=json.dumps(ev), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=tree, timeout=60)
    if p.returncode == 2: return "deny", p.stderr.strip()[:160]
    if p.stdout.strip():
        o = json.loads(p.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]; return o["permissionDecision"], o.get("permissionDecisionReason","")[:160]
    return ("allow" if p.returncode == 0 else "rc%d" % p.returncode), p.stderr.strip()[:160]
print("documented lines:", len(lines))
for l in lines:
    d, why = decide(l); print("DOC", d, "|", " ".join(l.split()[3:9]), "|", why)
for l in extra:
    d, why = decide(l); print("ROOT-INTO-WALLS", d, "|", " ".join(l.split()[3:9]))
